templates.title: Lantern River
templates.description: Drift down a river of lotus lanterns, open your memories on a hoa mai tree, and receive a lì xì at dawn.

templates.title: Đêm Rằm
templates.description: One Mid-Autumn night of a Hanoi childhood: build a star lantern on Hàng Mã, set the moon tray on the rooftop, drum for the lion dance, then walk the moon to meet Chị Hằng and Chú Cuội. Each stop teaches a custom.

templates.title: Non Nước Cao Bằng
templates.description: Explore one valley of Cao Bằng: Bản Giốc falls and the jade Quây Sơn, Mắt Thần mountain, a Tày stilt-house village with its water wheel and Phia Thắp incense, then singing round the fire at dusk.

templates.title: Snowglobe Letters
templates.description: Shake a snow globe to reveal a tiny village; each lit window opens a letter.

templates.title: Midnight Fireworks
templates.description: Count down on a rooftop and light fireworks that spell out your wishes.

templates.title: Our Constellation
templates.description: Connect the stars of your favourite moments into a constellation that is yours.

templates.title: Candle Wish
templates.description: A cake assembles layer by layer; blow out the candles to open the card.
